title: Squid in Garlic Butter
description: Crispy pan-seared squid served with a flavorful garlic butter sauce. Quick and easy to make for a delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.notes: Cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Rinse the squid pieces and pat dry.
In a bowl, mix together minced garlic and softened butter.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Place the squid pieces in a baking dish and drizzle with garlic butter mixture.
Bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped parsley if desired.
